description:
A text-based home screen with shortcuts, widgets and optional app limits.

BetterLauncher is a free, open-source Android launcher with a text-based home screen. Put your favorite apps and shortcuts within reach, without ads or paid upgrades.

Make it yours. Arrange up to eight apps and eight shortcuts. Add folders and an Android widget, adjust fonts and alignment, and make labels easier to read over your wallpaper.

Find and open apps. Search the app drawer with precise or flexible matching. You can also search Android settings and, with permission, your contacts.

Take breaks from distracting apps. Set optional cooldowns or require device authentication when opening selected apps from BetterLauncher. Save or restore your settings with a JSON backup.

Optional accessibility service. Double-tap screen lock, app cooldowns and optional Xiaomi gestures use Android Accessibility. The service uses window changes and the foreground app to enforce cooldowns and can read on-screen view information to recognize the lock gesture. This processing stays on your device. You can turn the service off and keep using the rest of the launcher.

BetterLauncher has no Android Internet permission or analytics. If you share a backup, Android hands it to the app or service you choose. Licensed under GPL-3.0.
